title: lotononis mollis
intro: Lotononis mollis, commonly known as Bushman's poison or White lotononis, is a plant species native to southern Africa. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotononis mollis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Research suggests that Lotononis mollis may have potential applications in the development of new medicines, although further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
